name: Delivery route → COHERENT: publish the delivery station (records pr.ref)
description:
The coherent delivery route (design R1/R6/D16, group 5+6). When the run's three independent delivery signals cohere — verify.result=pass (the clean-room cold proof), review.verdict.0=approved (Quinn's D16 verdict), and openspec.validated present (the OpenSpec oracle) — deliver: fire a plain `publish` to the DELIVERY STATION component (component.delivery-station.dispatch), which records pr.ref (the terminal of the m0 issue→PR arc) with ZERO model turns. This REPLACES the old check_coherence tool + its router rules (roll-up became rule conditions at group 5) AND the forced open_pr coordinator turn (became a publish-triggered component at group 6, R6): the deterministic delivery is now a component, not a paid model call.

WHY IT FIRES ON THE RUN (not a loop, unlike the floors/review routes): delivery is TERMINAL — it never repeats, so there is no per-attempt reset problem, and a run-scoped delivery.routed guard is correct. All three signals live on the RUN, so a run-fired rule reads them directly with NO mirror. It fires when verify.result=pass is stamped (the last-to-arrive signal; validated + approved are present earlier). At M0 (single task) the review roll-up is the literal review.verdict.0; the multi-task fan-in (count projected tasks vs approved) is the deferred M1 gated-DAG (R9).

TRIGGER: verify.result eq "pass" (required:false — absent = false, so no premature fire before the cold verify), review.verdict.0 eq "approved" (required:false, defense-in-depth — already true to have reached verify), openspec.validated length_gt 0 (required:true — presence at M0; a revision-match eq lands with semstreams #519's .value form, tripwired), and delivery.routed length_eq 0 (self-extinguish). A verify.result of 'retry' (a transient docker flake) matches neither this nor the blocked route (08b), so a flake never triggers delivery — verify re-runs.

HOW THE STATION GETS THE RUN: the rule fires on the RUN, so the rule engine's executePublish stamps the dispatch payload's entity_id = the run entity id; the delivery station reads req.EntityID (the run) and stamps pr.ref on it. No properties are needed (the run IS the firing entity). The station calls the SAME delivery core (openpr.Deliver) the old tool did — one writer of pr.ref (G5), one M0 stub form.

SELF-EXTINGUISHING ONE-SHOT (restart-safe, CRITICAL): on_enter FIRST stamps delivery.routed=$entity.instance on the run, guarded by delivery.routed length_eq 0, BEFORE the publish. Delivery is not idempotent to re-fire in spirit (a duplicate PR at M2), so this marker is load-bearing even though the M0 stamp is latest-wins; core NATS publish is fire-and-forget and not deduped. Mutually exclusive with the blocked route (08b) on verify.result.

metadata.station: delivery coherent → publish delivery-station → pr.ref (R1/R6/D16, group 5+6)
metadata.fires_on_run: delivery is terminal (never repeats), so this fires on the RUN with a run-scoped delivery.routed guard — no per-attempt reset, no mirror needed (all three signals are on the run). The RUN is the publish payload's entity_id, so the station stamps pr.ref on it with no properties.
metadata.trigger_rationale: verify.result=pass AND review.verdict.0=approved AND openspec.validated present. A 'retry' verify matches neither delivery route (it re-runs). openspec.validated length_gt 0 flips to a revision-match eq when semstreams #519's .value form lands (tripwired).
metadata.mechanism: R6: a plain `publish` to component.delivery-station.dispatch triggers the delivery STATION component (zero model turns), replacing the forced open_pr coordinator turn. The rule engine emits the publish on core NATS (the rule component declares no matching JetStream output port).
metadata.restart_safe: SELF-EXTINGUISHING via the RUN-scoped delivery.routed marker, stamped BEFORE the publish (fire-once dup-safety; a real forge PR at M2 is not idempotent). KNOWN M0 GAP (honest): because the marker is set before the effect and rules are edge-triggered, a PERSISTENT delivery-station fault (after the base's bounded retry) leaves delivery.routed set + pr.ref absent with nothing to re-trigger — the run does NOT auto-park at M0. The routed-without-result reconciliation (a marker-set-∧-result-absent park + effect idempotency on replay) is R8/group 8, pinned by TestDeliveryRoutedWithoutResultIsAKnownGap.
metadata.only_sanctioned_delivery_publisher: this is the ONLY rule that publishes the delivery station (pinned) — a second would risk a duplicate delivery.
